settings.heading: Become An Authorized Viking Sauna Dealer

settings.caption: Premium outdoor cedar saunas, distributed exclusively through our authorized dealer network.

settings.text:
Viking Sauna Co. partners with qualified retailers, contractors, and wellness professionals across North America to bring our handcrafted premium natural cedar saunas to market. We do not sell directly to the general public — all sales are fulfilled through our authorized dealer network.

If you’re interested in carrying Viking Sauna Co. products, we invite you to apply below.

Viking Sauna Co. works with established businesses in the following industries:

  • Outdoor living & backyard specialty retailers
  • Sauna & spa dealers
  • Wellness & fitness centers
  • Contractors & professional installers
  • Landscape & outdoor renovation companies

We do not offer dealer status to individual consumers or non-business applicants.

To ensure quality partnerships, all dealer applications are reviewed manually.

Application Process:

  1. Download our Dealer Application PDF
  2. Complete all required fields
  3. Email the completed application to dealers@vikingsaunaco.com
If you have questions about dealer qualifications, territory availability, or product logistics, please contact us at dealers@vikingsaunaco.com.
